_comment: Example registry. Copy it to ~/.config/ship-dag/hosts.json (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ship-dag/hosts.json, or the path in $SHIP_DAG_HOSTS) and edit it there; the real registry names your machines, so never commit it. Lists hosts other than this machine that can run a whole engine for a ready-wave. `local` is implicit and never listed. Keys are host names; an entry needs ssh (the ssh alias), home, reposDir (where the host's repo checkouts live), and sdHome (the host's ship-dag checkout), and may give coHome, sessionSlots and leaseSlots (positive integers) and toolchains (any of node, python, xcode). A repo or an issue picks a host with `host`: in references/repo-ci-profiles.json, or on a spec issue (which wins). emit-config --by-host splits a spec into one config per host; scripts/lib/split-by-host.mjs holds the toolchain guard.

mini._note: A placeholder. An 8 GB Mac that runs Xcode waves: host-run runs one session at a time for any wave that holds an Xcode repo, so sessionSlots 2 applies to node-only waves.
